facts.fact: La Nation's Djibouti Telecom profile lists two terrestrial cables in its network, one between Djibouti and Somalia and one between Djibouti and Ethiopia (profile text partly stale).
facts.system: Djibouti Telecom terrestrial cables to Somalia and Ethiopia

facts.system: Djibouti Telecom terrestrial cable to Ethiopia
